risks.note: Mr J L McIntosh ceased to be Managing Director on 1st March 2026 due to efflux of time and Mr Mihir Prakash Bajoria was appointed Managing Director from that date for a three year term; separately Mr Arasu Shanmugam resigned as Director and CEO India on 6th April 2026, with Mr Mukesh Harshadrai Rawal proposed to assume office as Director and CEO from 16th August 2026 subject to requisite approvals, meaning both the MD and the India CEO seats changed hands within a few months.
risks.risk: Leadership transition and succession risk at the top of the Company and of the India business

risks.note: Management states the Risk Management framework is aimed at effectively mitigating the Company's various business and operational risks through strategic actions, and that no elements of risk were identified that may threaten the existence of the Company - so the exposure is acknowledged and framework-managed rather than quantified.
risks.risk: Business and operational risk across manufacturing operations

risks.note: Cost pressures impacted short-term profitability and a few key financial ratios during FY 2025-26, which the Company is countering with operational efficiencies and a higher value-added product mix.

The Company states it continued to place utmost importance on IT security and strengthened it further, including by introducing additional checks and balances - an explicitly flagged and continuously reinforced watch area.
risks.risk: Information technology and cyber security risk

risks.note: The Company operates under SEBI LODR and Companies Act obligations with policies for Vigil Mechanism (Whistle Blower), Prevention of Sexual Harassment, Insider Trading and Risk Management, plus cost records, cost audit, secretarial audit and statutory audit; no complaints or alerts were received under these policies during the year and the auditors reported no qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer and no instances of fraud.

The Company depends on managerial and technical talent across a workforce of 1,513 people worldwide (including 1,180 in India) and is running a 'People First' program to strengthen employee engagement and well-being while investing in customer-facing teams.
